detail.selectCliente: Type to search a registered client by name, or enter a new one
detail.selectSuplidor: Type in the name to pick a registered supplier; code and nationality are filled in
detail.referenceHint: Leave empty to use Declaration No.
detail.importadorHint: Editing the importer automatically updates the consignee
detail.consignatarioHint: Auto-filled from the importer. Editing here unlinks the sync.
detail.checklistHint: Checking items updates the status automatically: any checked → Verified, all checked → Complete.
detail.puertoEntradaHint: Ports from the DGA master table; the UN/LOCODE goes into the SIGA XML
detail.documentoHint: Importer document (RNC, CED, PAS or TID)
detail.infoAdicionalHint: Completes the registration sheet and the transport fields the DUA requires.
detail.fechaLlegadaRealHint: Used for the Art. 52 surcharge calculation
detail.vuceHint: Local check of the tariff lines that usually need a permit. Always confirm in SIRE/VUCE.
detail.noTemporalError: These subheadings do not admit temporary products: they require the registered product article number.
detail.vuceSinPermisos: No line item on this file needs a VUCE permit according to the recorded rules.

importExport.title: Import / Export
importExport.importHint: Every sheet and every column is read. Each row is one line item; rows sharing a Reference become one file.
importExport.noRows: The file contains no data rows
importExport.unmappedColumns: Columns with no match (kept in the preview but not imported): {{cols}}
importExport.sigaNote: The SIGA XML follows the official ImportDUA.xsd / ExportDUA.xsd schemas published by the DGA (copies in docs/siga-xsd). Fields the app does not track (carrier, transport method) are exported empty to be completed in SIGA.

reports.title: Reports
reports.sinAcceso: Your user has no access to reporting.
reports.art52Nota: Art. 52 surcharge: files that arrived more than {{dias}} days ago and are still not filed. Already-filed ones are not evaluated because the filing date is not recorded.
reports.historialNota: A line item is not duplicated when it reappears on another file: that file is added to the existing row. It only duplicates when the tariff line or the product code changes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.tasaAutoNota: Pulling the rate automatically from the DGA page needs a backend: the browser cannot read aduanas.gob.do directly (CORS).
settings.diasArt52Hint: Days from arrival before the surcharge applies. Confirm the figure with the DGA.
settings.tarifarioHint: The agency service prices, used as a quoting reference.
settings.iscHint: Specific ISC amounts under Ley 11-92, art. 375. DGII indexes them to inflation every quarter: update them before pre-assessing. Each pre-assessment keeps the amounts it was run with.
settings.isc_alcoholPorLitro: Alcohol, per litre of absolute alcohol

preliq.confirmarRestablecer: Some rates were corrected by hand. Resetting reloads every rate from the tariff and discards those corrections.
preliq.noHecha: This file has not been pre-assessed yet.
preliq.hechaEl: Pre-assessed on {{fecha}}. The rates are frozen on the file.
preliq.explicacion: Pre-assessing loads each line's duty and ITBIS from the tariff (7th amendment), applies any ISC that is due, and computes what the declaration will owe. The rates are frozen on the file and any of them can be corrected by hand; the amounts are always recomputed from the current values.
preliq.errorArancel: The tariff could not be loaded.
preliq.resultadoNoEnArancel: Not in the tariff: {{codigos}}. Enter their rates by hand.
preliq.guardar: Save the file to keep the pre-assessment.
preliq.exportacion: Exports pay no import duty, ISC or ITBIS: there is nothing to pre-assess.
preliq.porLitroAlcohol: RD$ per litre of absolute alcohol
preliq.noEnArancel: This code is not a tariff subheading: enter the rates by hand.
preliq.nota_tabacoSinMonto: Tobacco product with no tabulated specific amount: check with DGII.
preliq.nota_iscSinSucesor: The ISC annex taxes a product of this subheading under a superseded code: check whether it applies.
preliq.tasaCambioUsada: Exchange rate used: RD$ {{tasa}} per US$.
preliq.avisoTasaCambio: The exchange rate is missing (Values tab): without it everything computes to zero.
preliq.avisoFob: The line items' FOB (US$ {{renglones}}) does not match the declared total FOB (US$ {{declarado}}). The pre-assessment uses the line items'.
preliq.avisoRegimen: The {{regimen}} regime may suspend or exempt taxes. This pre-assessment assumes clearance for consumption.
preliq.avisoAcuerdo: Agreement {{acuerdo}}: preferential rates are not applied automatically. Adjust the duty % of the qualifying lines.
preliq.avisoCargaSuelta: The service fee for loose cargo (per kilo or per tonne) is not included.
preliq.avisoPrecioVenta: Line {{codigo}}: the retail price is missing (line detail); it is the ISC base.
preliq.avisoGrado: Line {{codigo}}: the alcohol grade is missing (line detail).
preliq.avisoUnidadAlcohol: Line {{codigo}}: alcohol ISC is computed per litre, but the line's unit is not LITROS.
preliq.avisoUnidadTabaco: Line {{codigo}}: the specific ISC is computed per pack, but the line's unit is not UNIDADES.
preliq.avisoSinTasas_one: {{count}} line has no rates and adds nothing to the total. Press Pre-assess to load them or enter them by hand.
preliq.avisoSinTasas_other: {{count}} lines have no rates and add nothing to the total. Press Pre-assess to load them or enter them by hand.
